profile.headline: Software Engineer Infrastructure
profile.summary:
Hi there! I've worked primarily in backend and DevOps with AWS working on a TV web application deployed nationally and in data pipelines for a marketing platform. For the TV application I delivered news video content, a weather feed, and FEMA emergency alerts increasing total users and saving significant annual costs. In multiple projects I created and optimized cloud infrastructure with AWS, CI/CD pipelines with Terraform, frontends with React and TypeScript, and Node and PostgreSQL backends.

Thanks!

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description:
• Led development of a  TV web based app delivering video content, a weather feed, and FEMA emergency alerts in React and Typescript deployed via AWS services, increasing total users YoY and saving $2M+
• Created a monorepo multi pipeline CI/CD and Terraform flow in GitLab for a managed marketing platform, reducing deploy time from 15 minutes to 4 minutes
• Built a Databricks ETL pipeline using PySpark and SQL to deliver user and AdOps data into Yahoo Demand Side Platform via S3 bucket, enforcing 100% PII governance compliance
• Led an intern in building a web based TV app integrated directly with embedded system TV APIs using React, DynamoDB, WebSockets, and caching

positions.title: Kodely Engineering Tutor
positions.description: Led basic engineering and coding workshops for 2nd graders
